He uses black-gloved hands to smooth the brown mixture over a long, phallic-shaped chocolate structure that curves outward. The woman initially looks towards the screen, then covers her right eye with her hand, laughing and appearing visibly embarrassed while bright yellow and black-bordered text captions appear at the bottom of the frame.
